title: FusionSense Live Fall Detection
disclosure: Live research-prototype inference from synchronized ESP32 IMU and ESP32-CAM pose. It is not a clinical or emergency-response device.

model.name: FusionSense corrected masked IMU + camera fusion
model.scope_note: Step 8 pilot checkpoint; strict IMU + camera validity is required.

input_contract.fusion_policy: valid IMU and valid full-body camera pose required

radar.note: Not an input to this project

evaluation.scope: four-subject pilot; Subject3 validation has been observed during tuning

alert_policy.condition: both modalities valid and stand_to_fall probability >= threshold
